scope: Selected volunteering brokers and community resilience networks in London, Somerset Council and Cumbria. Not an exhaustive national directory.

records.name: London Plus · Volunteer Centre Network
records.role: Connects London’s borough volunteer centres, with a directory for local volunteer matching and support to organisations involving volunteers.
records.verification: Role checked against London Plus’s public page. Individual centres’ services and capacity require confirmation. Inclusion does not imply a NET relationship or participation in this pilot.
records.coverage_note: Pan-London network; individual volunteer centres generally work at borough level. No service boundaries have been verified.

evidence.claim: London Plus facilitates a pan-London Volunteer Centre Network; centres match volunteers with local organisations and support local emergency responses.

records.name: London Communities Emergencies Partnership
records.role: Supports charities and community groups before, during and after emergencies through preparedness, shared learning and connections across London.
records.verification: Public partnership description checked. A coordination network, not an advertised employee volunteering vacancy. Inclusion does not imply a NET relationship or participation in this pilot.
records.coverage_note: London-wide partnership, co-chaired by London Plus and the VCS Emergencies Partnership. No service boundaries or available volunteer capacity have been verified.

evidence.claim: The partnership supports London charities before, during and after emergencies and is co-chaired by London Plus and the VCS Emergencies Partnership.

records.name: HandsOn London
records.role: Arranges corporate volunteering with London community organisations, including support for people in difficult circumstances and a winter coat campaign.
records.verification: Corporate volunteering offer checked on the organisation’s public page. Project suitability, dates, costs and capacity must be agreed with the organisation. Inclusion does not imply a NET relationship or participation in this pilot.
records.coverage_note: Activities at centres across London or at an employer’s office, subject to the agreed project. No activity venues or service boundaries have been verified here.

evidence.claim: Offers corporate projects from short sessions to full days, including LiftUp Lives community support and WrapUp London coat distribution; companies are directed to enquire.

records.name: Spark Somerset
records.role: Supports volunteer recruitment and management for Somerset charities and community groups, and runs the Spark a Change volunteering platform.
records.verification: Role and platform link checked on Spark Somerset’s public page. Each host must confirm suitability and availability; no feed access has been agreed. Inclusion does not imply a NET relationship or participation in this pilot.
records.coverage_note: Somerset, as stated by Spark Somerset. Individual hosts’ service areas and activity locations vary; no service boundary has been inferred.

evidence.claim: Spark Somerset supports volunteer-involving organisations and directs volunteers to its Spark a Change platform for matching by skills, interests and location.

records.name: Somerset Prepared
records.role: Multi-agency partnership providing community emergency preparedness advice, support and training, with signposting to established voluntary response agencies.
records.verification: Partnership role and volunteering signpost checked on public pages. Response roles may require training and exercises; no one-day places or availability confirmed. Inclusion does not imply a NET relationship or participation in this pilot.
records.coverage_note: Somerset communities. The partnership’s public volunteering page links to agencies with different capabilities; no common service boundary or deployable capacity is inferred.

evidence.claim: Somerset Prepared describes itself as a multi-agency partnership supporting local resilience to emergencies.
Volunteering is signposted through Somerset Emergency Voluntary Agencies Group members, whose roles involve training and exercises.

records.name: Thrive · Community Council for Somerset
records.role: Supports volunteers who manage Somerset community buildings and spaces through practical advice, training and a community spaces directory.
records.verification: Community buildings support checked on Thrive’s public page. This is an organisational support route, not an advertised employee volunteering vacancy. Inclusion does not imply a NET relationship or participation in this pilot.
records.coverage_note: Somerset community buildings and spaces. A listed building is not automatically an emergency hub or a volunteer host; no service boundaries have been verified.

evidence.claim: Community Council for Somerset operates as Thrive and offers advice and support to volunteers running Somerset community spaces.

records.name: Cumbria CVS
records.role: Offers employer-supported volunteer brokerage, working with local organisations on practical projects and professional skills contributions.
records.verification: Employer-supported volunteering offer checked on Cumbria CVS’s public page. The organisation asks employers to discuss costings and arrangements; no project capacity confirmed. Inclusion does not imply a NET relationship or participation in this pilot.
records.coverage_note: Cumbria-wide support, as described by Cumbria CVS. Project locations and beneficiary areas must be agreed; no service boundaries have been inferred.

evidence.claim: Cumbria CVS supports ESV projects across the county and offers a brokerage service to develop, deliver, manage and evaluate schemes, with costings available by discussion.

records.name: ACTion with Communities in Cumbria
records.role: Supports communities across Cumbria with emergency planning, resilience guidance and community buildings, including information on community emergency hubs.
records.verification: Emergency planning role checked on ACT’s public page. Coordination and community support route, not an advertised one-day placement. Inclusion does not imply a NET relationship or participation in this pilot.
records.coverage_note: Across Cumbria; page provides resources for Cumberland and Westmorland and Furness. No specific hub availability or service boundaries have been verified.

evidence.claim: ACT supports community emergency planning across Cumbria and works with the Joint Emergency Management and Resilience Team, with resources on plans and community hubs.
